notes.summary: Adds ty return-type inference behind a new `analysis.return-type-inference` option, a new preview lint rule, and several lint and type-checking fixes; most other changes are CI and dependency maintenance.

features.description: ty adds return-type inference, disabled by default and enabled by setting `analysis.return-type-inference` to `"always"`.
ty shows return-type inlay hints for unannotated functions, with a "bake in" action, and skips hints that contain stub-only types.
The playground's default settings expose `analysis.return-type-inference`, set to `"never"`.
New preview lint rule `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile` flags `re.compile(p).match(s)`-style calls where the compiled pattern is only used in place.
`PLR2004` gains a configurable allowlist for magic values via `pylint.allow_magic_values`.
ty supports uv's nested `modules[name].owners` module-ownership metadata alongside the legacy `module_owners` field.

fixes.description: `PLE0643` no longer reports false positives when sequence literals contain starred elements.
`D417` now treats backslash-escaped `\*args` and `\*\*kwargs` as documented parameters.
The autofixes for `PLR5501` and `PLW0120` are now marked unsafe when they would delete a comment on the `else:` line.
The `UP035` autofix is now marked unsafe when the import contains comments that would be deleted.
`UP040`, `UP046`, `UP047` and `RUF053` no longer emit syntax errors for type variables with starred constraints.

Several ty crashes and false positives are fixed, including stack overflows on recursive descriptor setter types and negated recursive aliases, a panic on negating `Any` aliases, false `invalid-argument-type` errors for copied recursive dictionaries and callbacks returning gradual generics, and incorrect inference from incompatible union members.
ty now reports incompatible attributes inherited from different bases as `invalid-attribute-override` and rejects `runtime_checkable` on non-protocol classes as `invalid-argument-type`.
ty reports all missing `@override` decorators together instead of revealing them one at a time, and gives more accurate messages for read-only `TypedDict` keys on `del`, `pop` and `setdefault`.
ty preserves the read type of dynamic attributes after assignment and keeps runtime namespace fallbacks for partial stub packages.
The documentation clarifies editor configuration precedence, user-level configuration discovery, rule descriptions and tutorial examples.

other.description: The autofix descriptions for `UP040` and `UP047` no longer mention variance.
`stacker` is now an opt-in feature.

The playground's locked dependencies `fflate`, `ws`, `picomatch`, `tar`, `source-map-js`, `smol-toml` and Monaco (with DOMPurify) were updated past known security advisories, and the playground API's Wrangler dependencies were updated.
macOS releases now use the stable `sh.astral.ruff` code-signing identifier across architectures.

notes.summary: This release adds return-type inference and return-type inlay hints to ty, a new preview rule `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile`, a configurable allowlist for `PLR2004`, and fixes several crashes and false positives across ty and the linter.

features.description: Return type inference for unannotated functions in ty, disabled by default; enable with `analysis.return-type-inference = "always"`.
Return-type inlay hints for unannotated functions in ty's editor and playground integrations, including baking in the inferred type.
`analysis.return-type-inference` is exposed in the playground's default settings, set to `"never"`.
New preview rule `unnecessary-regular-expression-compile` (`complexity`) flags `re.compile(p).match(s)`-style calls where the compiled pattern is only used once.
New `pylint.allow_magic_values` setting lets you configure the allowlist for `magic-value-comparison` (`PLR2004`).
ty now reports incompatible attributes inherited from different bases (`invalid-attribute-override`), even when the subclass does not override them.
ty now reports `invalid-argument-type` when `runtime_checkable` is applied to a non-protocol class, including direct calls.
ty reads uv's nested `modules[name].owners` module-ownership metadata in addition to the legacy `module_owners` field.
ty reports all missing `@override` decorators for a property at once instead of one per run.
ty allows subclasses to disable or restore hashability, validating each `__hash__` against `object.__hash__` or `None`.
ty validates `TypeAliasType` keyword arguments and recognizes the `qualname` parameter on Python 3.15+.

fixes.description: Fixed a false positive in `potential-index-error` (`PLE0643`) on sequences containing starred expressions.
`pydocstyle` `D417` now treats backslash-escaped `\*args` and `\*\*kwargs` as documented.
`PLR5501` and `PLW0120` fixes are now marked unsafe when they would delete a comment on the `else:` line.
`UP035` fixes are now marked unsafe when a comment inside the `from typing import (...)` statement would be deleted.
`UP040`, `UP046`, `UP047` and `RUF053` fixes no longer produce syntax errors for type variables with starred constraints.
Fixed a stack overflow when checking recursive descriptor setter types and protocols with recursive writable members.
Fixed crashes when negating recursive aliases and panic when negating dynamic (`Any`) aliases.
Fixed recursive type materialization, avoiding false `invalid-argument-type` errors for `dict(value)` and stack overflows on negated recursive aliases.
Fixed false `invalid-argument-type` errors when inferring constrained type variables from callbacks returning a gradual generic type.
Fixed over-narrow inferred return types when a generic call has multiple valid solutions with invariant return types.
Fixed incorrect inference when incompatible union members contributed constraints during union assignability checks.
Fixed constructor inference so type variable defaults are not resolved before `__init__` has a chance to constrain them.
Fixed tuple-length promotion to consider only the outer element types, so tuples nested deeper no longer block it.
Fixed a panic from clearing cached ASTs in more language server operations.
Fixed partial stub packages hiding runtime submodules; runtime namespace candidates are now preserved when resolving descendants.
Fixed protocol receiver compatibility checks incorrectly establishing strict subtyping through gradual types.
Fixed universal protocol checks to preserve receiver-specific `Self` requirements for writable `__class__`.
Fixed `Self` type variables in synthesized methods sharing a single identity, which could collapse unions of `_replace` methods from different named tuples.
Fixed union normalization performance by rejecting impossible generic intersection comparisons early.
Fixed read types for dynamic attributes after assignment, so narrowing to the right-hand side no longer rejects valid `__getattr__` access.
Fixed `TypedDict` diagnostics to report read-only keys as the reason for rejecting `del`, `pop`, and `setdefault`.
Fixed a stack overflow when a protocol's writable member has a descriptor setter accepting a recursive type.
Go-to-implementation textual prefilters were clarified and split into separate member-name and `class` keyword matchers.
Fixed stale configuration guidance in the documentation, including editor configuration precedence and user-level configuration discovery.
Removed incorrect variance-related mentions from the `UP040` and `UP047` fix safety documentation.
Avoided inserting inlay hints that contain stub-only types such as `Unknown` from `ty_extensions`.

other.description: `stacker` is now an opt-in feature.
Ruff's documentation publishing now uses Python 3.13.
macOS releases now use the stable `sh.astral.ruff` code-signing identifier across architectures; rules tied to the unprefixed x86_64 identifier need a one-time update.
Playground dependencies `fflate`, `ws`, `picomatch`, `tar`, `source-map-js`, `smol-toml`, Monaco/DOMPurify, and the Wrangler API stack were updated to address security advisories.

notes.summary: Flask 3.1.0 adds secret key rotation, trusted hosts, session cookie partitioning, and limit configuration, and drops support for Python 3.8.

features.description: Secret key rotation is supported via the `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` config.
Added `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config and `request.trusted_hosts` to validate the request host.
Added `SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED` config to enable partitioned session cookies.
Configurable limits and documentation added for request size and other limits.
Added `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config and docs.
Added `SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN` caveat documentation.
Added `encoding` parameter to `open_resource`.
Added configuration option to control automatic OPTIONS responses.

fixes.description: Setting `SERVER_NAME` no longer restricts routing when `subdomain_matching` or `host_matching` is enabled.
Updated environment file precedence.
Updated minimum blinker version to 1.9.

other.description: Session objects now use generic base classes.
Updated example and tutorial compatibility and metadata.
Added sqlite datetime converter to examples.

reference_items.text: Drop support for Python 3.8
Update minimum dependency versions (Werkzeug >= 3.1, ItsDangerous >= 2.2, Blinker >= 1.9)
Provide a configuration option to control automatic option responses
open_resource/open_instance_resource and Blueprint.open_resource take an encoding parameter
Request.max_content_length customizable per-request; add MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE and MAX_FORM_PARTS config; document resource limits
Add support for Partitioned cookie attribute with SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED config
-e path takes precedence over default .env and .flaskenv; load_dotenv loads defaults unless load_defaults=False
Support key rotation with SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS config
Fix how host_matching=True or subdomain_matching=False interacts with SERVER_NAME; SERVER_NAME no longer restricts requests
Request.trusted_hosts is checked during routing, settable via TRUSTED_HOSTS config

generated_items.reason: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH already existed; the commits add MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE and MAX_FORM_PARTS and per-request max_content_length, not a new MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH config.
